'''An'bal''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the noble [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]] as a [[Grand Marshal/Legends|Grand Marshal]] in their military forces during the [[Alderaan Civil War]]. She commanded the [[Organa medical camp]] in the [[Juran Mountains/Legends|Juran Mountains]], but was [[Death/Legends|slain]] during an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial assault]] on the camp.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
An'bal appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an Elite boss on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] in the Organa medical camp. She is not directly involved in any quests, but can be [[Death/Legends|killed]] for loot, and as part of an achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means she was killed.
